scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.js vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts apps packages
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.js vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts apps packages
scripts.typecheck: if find apps packages -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/dist/*' -print -quit | grep -q .; then tsc --project tsconfig.json; else echo 'No TypeScript workspace sources to check.'; fi
